data.long_meaning: In Greek, Gilemette is derived from 'Gileas' meaning 'father's joy' and 'mete' meaning 'measure' or 'land'. This beautiful name signifies a precious jewel born from the joy of one's father's land. The name Gilemette carries the meaning “Jewel of my father's land” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gilemette usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel of my father's land and live with faith, good character and purpose.
